data.exact_reserve_text: Changes for prior years Gross 27,071 Reinsurance (6,265) Net 31,478
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross adverse claims development (strengthening) of GBP 27.071 million for prior underwriting years. This was primarily driven by a significant increase in the incurred claims position and ultimate claims estimates for the 2013 and prior years of account, particularly affecting professional indemnity, directors and officers, medical malpractice, and accident & health classes. The 2014 year of account also saw adverse development due to the materialisation of large losses and a large loss load. Net adverse development was reported as GBP 18.1 million for 2013 and prior years, GBP 3.4 million for 2014, and GBP 0.2 million for 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration that arose on the 2013 and prior years of account on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
significant increase in the incurred claims position on individual claims of GBP 16.5m gross
moving the ultimate claims position out by GBP 26.7m gross
incurred movements GBP 10.3m gross relates to the primary professional indemnity account
Late reporting on the personal accident account also caused the incurred position to move by some GBP 3.2m
materialisation of a number of large losses particularly under the directors and officers account
claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
net adverse claims development of GBP 18.1 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 3.4 million on the 2014 year and GBP 0.2 million on the 2015 year of account.
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 19 states net adverse claims development of GBP 18.1m on 2013 and prior, GBP 3.4m on 2014, and GBP 0.2m on 2015, summing to GBP 21.7m net. However, the 'Changes for prior years' line in the Technical Provisions table on page 18 reports a total net strengthening of GBP 31.478m and a gross strengthening of GBP 27.071m. The table figure is used as the primary source for total gross prior year development.
